The exact `project:goal-tree` session was not found; related Living Memory records establish:
- Decomposition: one local `SPEC`, explicit child `postcondition_targets`, forward/reverse `COVERAGE`, executable acceptance checks and required artifacts; missing `P10` coverage broke `rise/gemini-comparator-execution/execute-frozen-comparator` (`01KS1AJE1TW1XCTR24AEG4EDDX`).
- Manifest verification: `scripts/generate_capability_manifests.py --out artifacts/capability --train-count 10000 --eval-count 1000 --holdout-count 1000 --verify-disjoint`; six manifests, `leakage_checks.ok=true`, 10 focused tests after envelope-proof fixes.
- Hash pitfall: regeneration preserves hashes at the same `--out`; changing output directories changes hashes because metadata embeds that path (`01KS11Q1ZASTFGJ3MFZ7THP1Z2`).
- Evidence-root pitfall: freshness reads `_DiskLoc`/`_GitLoc` under `PROJECT_ROOT`, not producer/consumer worktrees, `NODE_DIR`, or `_ae_artifact_evidence_extra_roots`.
- Ignored artifacts and `.src.sha256` sidecars can copy to the parent worktree without entering its commit, leaving sibling consumers without them (`01M2G1K4J233HBS5EC14QN02BC`, verified 2026-09-14).
